Create and manage incident records

Creates a new incident record in Datadog Incident Management. An incident captures an outage or issue, including its title, severity, status, customer impact description, and associated fields. Creating an incident triggers notifications to configured responders and creates a dedicated Slack channel if configured. The incident is assigned a unique ID and timestamped at creation time. Custom fields configured in your organization settings can be set on incident creation.

The Datadog Incidents API allows you to manage incident response, as well as associated attachments, metadata, and todos. It also supports creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving services associated with incidents. Incidents capture the full lifecycle of an outage or issue including detection, investigation, remediation, and post-mortem analysis. The Incidents feature requires the Incident Management product and appropriate permissions within your Datadog organization.
